facts.fact: Mwananchi reports on 12 June 2026 the PDPC speaking on implementation of the Personal Data Protection Act, Chapter 44.

The PDPC gave institutions with incomplete registration seven days to finish and told unregistered ones to start at once, warning of fines or administrative action; it also invited complaints from citizens.
PDPC Director General Dr Emmanuel Mkilia addressed journalists in Dodoma on 12 June 2026 on implementation of the Act.
